title: Retaining wall and deck extension on a shared boundary: B1 and E1 (Stepneyville, Nelson)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
code_edition: NZ Building Code B1, B2 and E1 as cited
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Owners built a deck extension, a new retaining wall and other structures along the boundary with a neighbouring property; the neighbour applied for the determination; Nelson City Council is the authority.
Matter: compliance with B1 Structure and E1 Surface Water as they protect other property.
Ministry experts' initial report and addendum, party responses and draft determination form part of the record (§5–9).

Decision (28 April 2022): owners' retaining wall complies with B1; structures on or adjacent to the boundary do not comply with B1 or B2 as it relates to B1; deck extension and other building work comply with E1.3.1 for protection of other property.
